newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee trading cautiously at 35.70 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee trading cautiously at 35.70 per dlr.

text.p: The Indian rupee was trading cautiously above 35.700 per dollar in early Tuesday deals as banks looked towards the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for possible intervention, dealers said.
"The Delhi market bought at 35.7025 today," a dealer at a Bombay bank said. On Monday, the rupee traded below 35.70-mark as the market did not expect RBI intervention until afternoon.
But the RBI surprised the market by intervening early in the day. "If they don't come in, the rupee could slip past the mark today also," a dealer said.
